text: Based on the available evidence, it's unclear whether the asset has lost tree cover since 2020. The assessment found insufficient evidence due to missing data coverage—the required satellite observations (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021) were not available for this asset. This means neither tree-cover loss nor its absence can be confirmed. The evidence does not support any conclusion about compliance or deforestation status. Further data or higher-resolution imagery would be needed to determine if tree-cover loss occurred.
